summary: Frontend-only tests for the new Collaboration Room feature on ChallengeDetail page. Verified: render, empty state, post as citizen with role tag, send button disabled/enabled state, input clears, role switch via header selector (navigates to /workspace) with thread persistence, cross-role posting shows correct role tags, reload persistence via jmib_challenges_v4 localStorage, and no console errors. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: CollaborationRoom.jsx: consider auto-scrolling thread to bottom on new message (currently max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto but no scroll-to-bottom).
store.jsx addMessage uses Date.now() for message IDs — rapid double-clicks could produce duplicate IDs; consider crypto.randomUUID().
No Enter-to-send affordance on the textarea (minor UX).
seed_data_creation: None. Used SEED challenge jmib-demo-water-001 after clearing localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Collaboration Room verified end-to-end. Role selector navigates to /workspace as expected; user must re-open challenge URL to see thread. Thread persists in localStorage key jmib_challenges_v4 under challenge.thread.
